```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
df_unedited <- read_excel(here("Boylston", "Boylston.xlsx"))
```

```{r}
# USECODE
# FUELTYPE
# AREASQ
# STORYHEIGHT

df_filtered <- df_unedited %>%
  select(`Primary Use`, VNS_HEAT_FUEL_DESC, `Living Area/GBA`, VNS_STORIES) %>%
  rename(USECODE = `Primary Use`, FUELTYPE = VNS_HEAT_FUEL_DESC, AREASQ =  `Living Area/GBA`, STORYHEIGHT = VNS_STORIES) %>%
  mutate(USECODE = substr(USECODE, 1, 3))
```

```{r}
write.csv(df_filtered, file = "Boylston_Final.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
